versions.subject: feat: new rules, updates and goofy guineapig stuff (#4229)
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.ps1'
filter_main_psscriptpolicytest:
    TargetFilename|contains: '__PSScriptPolicyTest_'
filter_main_appdata:
    TargetFilename|startswith: 'C:\Users\'
    TargetFilename|contains: '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
filter_main_windows_temp:
    TargetFilename|startswith: 'C:\Windows\Temp\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") TargetFilename="*.ps1" NOT (TargetFilename="*__PSScriptPolicyTest_*" OR (TargetFilename="C:\\Users\\*" TargetFilename="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*") OR TargetFilename="C:\\Windows\\Temp\\*")
